scope.description: Source review of the WorkBuddy supported-Node and private temporary npm-cache launch, installation and retry binding, verification process cleanup, onboarding guidance and release version changes.
finalIncrementsReviewed: WorkBuddy custom-connector navigation and first-install or changed-command trust guidance plus its two assertions.
Test-only lint changes: an explicitly typed mock call signature and an equivalent four-space regular expression.
Client test compatibility change from replaceAll to equivalent split and join calls.

independence.independentlyReviewedByThisReviewer: All reviewed changes except the two server files listed below.

independentlyReviewedByParent.result: No blocking findings; the parent confirmed the current-version-only branch, preparation before npx, explicit WorkBuddy cache and agent arguments, separate other-host command and preserved historical compatibility.

sourceFingerprint.changedSourceAlgorithm: SHA-256 over sorted repository-relative changed or untracked file paths, each followed by NUL, file bytes and NUL; agentwiki/docs is excluded.

resolvedFindings.result: The actual launch rechecks the cache path, directory type, ownership and private permissions, rejects unsafe existing paths, and recreates a missing cache with mode 0700 before loading the official npx CLI.
Windows environment merging normalizes variable casing and uses the same effective environment for runtime selection and verification. Native Windows acceptance is outside this receipt.
Retry validation is read-only: a changed command is rejected without execution and a missing disposable cache is not recreated during validation.
Creation and validation follow the merged temporary-directory environment. An isolated real Node and npm launch succeeded after its cache was removed and recreated privately.

Verification resolves after bounded cleanup of its owned process group or tree. An isolated run of the actual gateway with a pending HTTP request no longer left the gateway alive 500 ms after timeout.

A private installation receipt binds the complete installed configuration, connection and confirmed original backup. Retry and verification readback reject changed environment values; the harmless NODE_OPTIONS preload probe was not executed after the fix.

Current-version installation-code instructions now prepare the actual WorkBuddy runtime, private temporary cache, matching absolute npx and child PATH before executing the pinned package. WorkBuddy uses --cache before the package and --agent workbuddy. Historical 0.13.2 and 0.13.3 instructions remain unchanged.

verification.command: pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-local-sync exec vitest run src/installer/workbuddy-runtime.spec.ts src/installer/client-config.spec.ts src/onboarding/install.spec.ts src/onboarding/verifier.spec.ts src/onboarding/steps-install-safety.spec.ts --testTimeout=20000

acceptanceBoundary: This receipt records source review and isolated source verification; it does not substitute for a real WorkBuddy client session.
Real WorkBuddy tool discovery, trust dialogs and page reads are recorded separately by the parent task.
Native Windows execution and ACL behavior were not independently accepted on a Windows host in this review.
Full prepack, build, packaging, publication and deployed-version acceptance are separate release gates and are not claimed by this receipt.
privacy: Repository-relative source paths and hashes only; no user configuration, credentials, private filesystem paths or connection identifiers are included.
